scope: Lossless storage and Go inference for the already published fresh shared-local Gooo three-choice models; no optimization updates or new quality selection.
invariants: No re-quantization: loaded matrix scales, temperature and all retained float bits remain identical.
Reject untied input/output matrices, nonzero off-block values, and noncanonical nonpositive-zero removed slots.
Retain each complete input and the same 24-term output accumulation order.
All 10739 frozen initial/feedback states times three variants: bitwise equal features, hidden values, logits, probabilities and argmax; report any failure without replacing or trimming cases.
Separate valid warmed allocation probes and fixed interleaved latency measurements; hardware/sample conditions must accompany results.

Artifact hashes truthfully identify compact bytes. Existing seed identity semantics remain; cross-format seeded choices are not required equal. Repeated same compact artifact and seed must remain reproducible.
Unsupported input, missing model, full-input bounds, cancellation, concurrent immutable model use and feedback repinning remain enforced.
Quality results are the prior observed development cohort, not a new holdout or a model accuracy improvement.

planned_native_followup.mode: Unseeded codegen immediately followed by native body execution, pair retained expanded/compact variants, record exact compiler and SDK revisions; no barrier before all codegen completes.

preserve: Original training/checkpoints and every previous experiment evidence directory

publication: Commit Go source/protocol and bounded evidence to public GitHub, then append model artifacts and measured results to the existing public HF model; never publish private paths, credentials or environment dumps.
